ND.notes: Official 2026 House reporting-unit returns reconcile to all 53 counties and statewide totals. The official layer explicitly describes 2026 election precinct splits; its CountyID and Precinct fields must match each county's complete reporting set. All parts are dissolved into one geometry per reporting unit, with votes counted once. Morton is withheld for conflicting county IDs; Towner is withheld for a malformed extra precinct code. Native Esri ring roles preserve holes that the service's GeoJSON export misgroups. Area-preserving topology repairs are individually audited. Overlay processing uses a 1e-9-degree coordinate grid. Ambiguous overlapping boundary strips are excluded from both precincts, leaving state fallback colors there. Votes still describe entire reporting units, not clipped-area allocations. The full original boundaries and ambiguity mask are downloadable. No distinct mapped reporting-unit polygons overlap beyond the audited numeric tolerance. Unofficial candidate votes are not turnout. Separate ballot counts have no precinct denominator; all rates are withheld.
ND.next_action: Resolve Morton parent IDs and Towner malformed precinct code with official crosswalk evidence; obtain precinct electorate denominators and certified returns.
